text:
anya: Night-owl rollout plan - US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 00:30-04:30 UTC. Target tag: v2.15.1. Canary in us-west for 20m. We'll keep EU at single-canary until US stable. APAC requires partner quota handshake before full ramp.
ben: Quick capacity read: us-west warm pool = 140k tok/min, eu-central = 90k, apac-tok = 60k. Can we earmark +15k reserve in US and EU? APAC partner only allows a soft bump of +5k.
harry: I can reserve +15k for US/EU. APAC bump needs approval windows from partner ops; I'll DM them now.
anya: Good. Add fallback plan: if Dedicated pool in any region nears 85% fill for 4m, auto-route 30% of that region's traffic to hosted fallback with q4_0 quantization. ops-bot, add that policy to the routing engine.
ops-bot: rule created: "dedicated_pool_fill>85pct_4m -> route 30pct->hosted:q4_0". Will post decisions to thread.
deploy-bot: starting canary: v2.15.1 -> us-west-canary (slot: wcan-3). Health probes ON. Trace and logs to https://logs.company/release/1748005555
julia: Runtime change note: v2.15.1 includes kernel selector tweak (prefer fused-cuda kernels for short tokens) and a memory resizing default. Expect p50 latency down for small requests, but watch p99 on 8k+ seqs.
ben: Canary smoke plan: 1) 60s spike 1500r/s 2) run real-prod sample prompts (20) 3) check embedding diffs 4) cost delta check vs v2.14.0. I'll kick synthetic spike.
ben: `hey deploy-bot spike 1500rps 60s`
deploy-bot: synthetic spike accepted; monitoring GPU, mem, queue depth. Report in ~70s.
harry: Networking: regional route weights set to local-first. We'll hold EU to 5% until US steady for 25m. APAC remains at canary 2% until partner confirms.
julia: Observability added quick dashboards: KV hit rate, kernel-type-distribution, mem-eviction-counts. URL: https://obs/redwood/1748005555
ops-bot: canary-health: p50 +18ms, p95 +55ms, errors +0.4pct. No OOMs. KV hit rate +6pct.
ben: Canary looks fine. No token-cost spike on sampled set. Start US ramp: 25% every 10m. Target 100% by 01:10 UTC.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift applied: us-west->us-region 25%. snapshot: r-1748005555-1
harry: After first ramp: CPU steady, GPU util +8pct, warm pool increased +10k. Reserve applied in us/eu. APAC still waiting on partner.
anja: small typo - should be anya :)
anya: corrected :)
ben: Observability - tail p99 for long seqs increased by +120ms. Julia - is this expected because of kernel selection?
julia: Yes a bit. Kernel fused path improves short token speed but for 8k+ sequences we may hit a less-optimized path. I flagged it. Set guard: if p99 > +200ms for 10m -> trigger rollback.
ops-bot: alert rule added: p99_longseq_delta > 200ms_10m -> post alert + page oncall.
deploy-bot: us-region at 60% scheduled in 8m.
harry: Partner ops replied: APAC extra quota approved but only as soft-burst (throttled) capped at +8k for first 2 hours. We'll need to limit ramp speed there.
anya: OK. Let's formalize rollback triggers: 1) sustained error rate increase >=8% over baseline for 5m; 2) GPU OOMs > 3 in any region within 10m; 3) p99 latency regression >200ms sustained 10m; 4) token-cost increase >7% across sampled traffic for 15m. Rollback pin: v2.14.0.
ben: Agreed. Also: if quota/backpressure in APAC occurs, auto-divert to hosted fallback with model small-serve:q4_0 and mark incidents.
julia: I pushed a quick change to tracing to log kernel type and batch size for each request to help debug latency tails. Link: https://traces.company/1748005555
harry: Ops checklist in runbook: `runbook:night-roll:v2.15.1 -> verify reserve, enable route-fallback, watch mem_eviction, pin v2.14.0 if triggers`
anya: Release notes draft for support: "v2.15.1: kernel selector tuning, memory resizing defaults, improved per-token latency for short prompts; note: APAC soft-burst enabled; may see p99 delta on very long sequences." Put that in releases doc.
ben: Pushed docs: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.15.1. Billing team has view-only access for cost anomaly watch.
ops-bot: canary health check at +30m: no OOMs, errors stable, KV hit +7pct.
deploy-bot: us-region at 85% now. Remaining ramp to 100% in 8m unless triggers. snapshot: r-1748005555-2
julia: Memory eviction counts creeping up in US for long seqs. Current mem_eviction_us = 62 events/10m. Watchlist.
ben: If mem_eviction spikes >120/10m -> immediate roll to v2.14.0.
anya: Oncall: who's shadowing US ramp?
harry: I'm on first watch. Tag me on any page.
ops-bot: page policy: mem_eviction_us > 120/10m or GPU_OOMs > 3 -> page harry + anya + deploy-team
anya: EU ramp plan: once US steady 30m at 100%, start EU at 15% then 25% steps, keep APAC to slow drip (max 10% per 20m) due to partner.
ben: Final go/no-go at 01:05 UTC. If all clear US will be full and EU canary start.
anja: again small typo :)
anya: ha, fixed :D
harry: small operational note: I've enabled a temporary traffic mirroring of 1% to the previous model v2.14.0 for QA sampling during ramp so we can diff outputs without affecting users.
julia: Good idea. That will help spot quality regressions.
ops-bot: thread automation: will post hourly updates and immediate alerts if any triggers.
deploy-bot: final update: last check-in +45m. US: 100% stable for 34m. EU: canary 15%. APAC: soft-burst 5% with +8k burst cap. No rollbacks triggered yet.
